description.narrative: Burundi, RSSH, Ministry of Public Health and Fight against AIDS of the Republic of Burundi (MoH Burundi)This program has the following goals: Contribuer à l'amelioration de la disponiblité , de l'accessibilité des soins et des services de santé. To contribute to the improvement of the availability and accessibility of health care and services.. The objectives of this program are: Améliorer la qualité et la disponibilité des données de routine en assurant que 95% des établissements de santé rapportent leurs données dans le système national d'informations sanitaires d'ici fin 2023. Improve the quality and availability of routine data by ensuring that 95% of health facility report routine data through the national HMIS by end of 2023. Améliorer la qualité des services laboratoires en initiant 173 laboratoires dans le processus d'assurance qualité d'ici fin 2023. Improve the quality of lab services by initiating 173 laboratories in the quality assurance process by end of 2023

Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Percentage of facilities providing diagnostic services on the day of the assessment

HIV I-Other 1 Number of new HIV infections per 1000uninfected population
Malaria I-Other 1 Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy orRDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
TB I-Other 1 TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for BDI-S-UGADSP01
Percentage of National Reference Laboratories accredited according to ISO15189 standard or achieving at least 4 stars towards accreditation
Timeliness of facility reporting: Percentage of submitted facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Proportion of community health workers who received at least one supportive supervision during the reporting period
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
Percentage of service delivery reports from community health workers integrated into HMIS
